snippet.title: Gorilla Tag Contagion | Coming to PC & Console 2027
snippet.description:
Gorilla Tag Contagion is a co-op survival roguelike that casts you as an employee of the mysterious Gorilla Corp. 

Smash, climb, and roll your way through hordes of enemies! Unlock new characters, powerful weapons, endless gadgets, and crazy parkour skills as you fight twisted monstrosities with your unique build. 

Team up with other Monke in coop and outlast the outbreak, together!

Coming to PC and Console 2027! 

Wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4610850/Gorilla_Tag_Contagion/

More info at https://www.gtcontagion.com

#gtag #gorillatag #gtcontagion #contagion
